expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The last message only says "Tests pass." It does not mention the 2024 incident in which fresh idempotency keys on retries charged 41 members twice, or explain why every attempt sends the same key.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step None; first edit at step 1

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back members charged twice when a timed-out attempt had already
charged the card, as in 2024.
expectations.evidence: The change moves `key = uuid.uuid4().hex` inside the retry loop, creating a fresh idempotency key per attempt. The only message is "Tests pass." No warning explains that this brings back members being charged twice when a timed-out attempt had already charged the card, as in 2024.
